name: Daily Fantasy Vlog Pipeline
description: Generates a 10-minute vlog video using ComfyUI and Lora, and uploads it to YouTube publicly.

steps.title: Generate Daily Vlog
steps.description: Generate today's 10-minute fantasy vlog using the established ComfyUI + LoRA pipeline. Ensure visuals, pacing, and audio match the reference aesthetic. Launch long renders (ComfyUI, LoRA, audio synthesis, ffmpeg assembly) in the background, record each completed step in progress.md (`- [x] step — evidence`), and emit a line starting with `WAITING_ON_BACKGROUND:` while a render is still running — never block synchronously until the 50-minute timeout.
acceptance: One rendered video file (.mp4) is saved in the artifacts dir; name it in the result
The file has both a video and an audio stream
A thumbnail image and title/description text for the upload are saved next to it
verify: ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_type -of csv=p=0 <video>.mp4  # lists video and audio

steps.title: Upload Vlog to YouTube (Public)
steps.description: Upload the generated vlog to the Gentle Soul YouTube channel as a PUBLIC video. Use ~/.priv/gentle_soul_youtube_token.json.
acceptance: The video from the generate-vlog step is uploaded to the Gentle Soul channel with privacyStatus public
The result contains the YouTube video id and URL https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>
If the OAuth token is expired or upload fails, the result ends with STATUS: BLOCKED and the error, not a claimed upload
verify: YouTube Data API videos.list?part=status,snippet&id=<id> with the Gentle Soul token → status.privacyStatus == public
